newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Two Singapore soldiers killed in NZ army accident.
newsitem.headline: Two Singapore soldiers killed in NZ army accident.

text.p: Two Singaporean soldiers were killed and 12 soldiers injured in New Zealand on Sunday when a shell exploded prematurely in a training accident, Radio New Zealand reported.
The accident happened at the central North Island army training base of Waiouru, it said.
The injured, all but one Singaporeans, were being ferried by four helicopters to nearby hospitals, an army spokesman told the radio.
A witness said that it appeared a field gun had exploded. Singapore soldiers commonly train in New Zealand because of the shortage of facilities and space at home.
